title: Class-II source, translated model, balanced coefficient jets, and obstruction boundary
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A13 sharp physical cubes, all prior A13 reductions remain binding at T4. R-089 proves the global polar/Douglas terminal Cameron--Martin contraction for every finite-cutoff cylindrical-simple progressive control, independent of time partition, range overlap, and revisit multiplicity. Hilbert martingale orthogonality supplies a weighted terminal-shell one-use ledger and extends R-088's pure-control quartic terminal bridge to the general progressive class. Summing every physical control shell before squaring gives an exact complete-cross-shell first-order Cartan Fourier trace and reduces direct integrated CFAR to the nonlinear coefficient-tail energy (3.12), which remains open. The s=1/4 quartic route has powers 5/16 and 9/16 with slack 1/8, while an exact nonzero frequency-32 harmonic rules out a homogeneous quartic-only closure. The rational packet has an exact Taylor-coordinate conditional form; under covariance matching it is universally nonnegative iff L is PSD and B_T+2 eta I is PSD. The production ray has L/e=-1/432, and a centered covariance-matched same-root fixture is negative, so the complete heat/lower-chaos forest remains load-bearing. R-087 CORE makes full OVERLAP exactly equivalent to the q=10/9 Nelson bound; controlled-shell one-use and complete temporal packets belong inside/before OVERLAP. The nonlinear Cartan coefficient-tail energy, complete same-root rational heat/forest packet, REG, uniform OVERLAP, Nelson, an interacting measure, and Sector A remain open.

R-089's pathwise terminal compression applies to every finite-cutoff cylindrical-simple progressive control and its H2 consequence uses A8 symbol coercivity plus the fixed regulator multiplier bound. It extends only the pure-control quartic terminal bridge; the lower-order nonlinear Cartan coefficient tails remain open. The exact Cartan Fourier trace retains all cross-shell terms before the square and proves a reduction, not the coefficient energy (3.12). The homogeneous quartic and rational mean-spectral fixtures are method no-gos, not counterexamples to the complete coupled form. The rational conditional identity uses finite second moments and coefficient measurability; the complete same-root heat/lower-chaos forest may cancel its negative subpacket. These results do not prove direct controlled Cartan CFAR, complete rational or signed NEAR, REG, uniform OVERLAP, Nelson, cutoff or floor removal, or any measure theorem.
falsifier: A failure of any prior A13 package assertion remains a falsifier for that package. R-089 is additionally falsified by failure of T T^*=C, a global compression ratio above one, revisit multiplicity in the normalized terminal CM norm, failure of Hilbert martingale orthogonality, an incorrect full-cross-shell Cartan Fourier trace or two-tail bound, a zero or incorrect frequency-32 harmonic, a wrong s=1/4 exponent/slack ledger, failure of the rational Taylor-coordinate identity, a nonnegative production L(-1/2), a nonnegative centered same-root fixture, failure of the exact OVERLAP--Nelson variational equivalence, an evidence hash, the nine-page zero-form PDF contract, visual QA, any pinned 56/44/169/269 assertion count, or a release assertion.

no_overclaim: R-089 proves global progressive terminal covariance compression and its martingale/spatial ledger, extends only the pure-control quartic terminal bridge, proves the exact complete-cross-shell Cartan Fourier trace reduction, the rational Taylor-coordinate mean-spectral boundary, and the OVERLAP--Nelson equivalence. It does not prove the nonlinear Cartan coefficient-tail energy, complete same-root rational heat/forest packet, complete rational or signed NEAR, REG, uniform OVERLAP, Nelson, a measure theorem, or Sector-A closure; all remain open.
